name: base_utils
description: Manages common host utilities, including an optional /etc/motd and a configurable list of utility packages, along with custom Puppet extensions and health-check functionality.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Deploys a Python application backed by PostgreSQL, including dependencies, repository-based application files, environment configuration, systemd service management, monitoring, logging, backups, and health checks.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Installs and configures HAProxy with data-driven frontend and backend settings, health checks, optional TLS and discovery, custom error pages, service ordering, firewall integration, and a statistics endpoint.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs PostgreSQL using the PGDG repository with configurable version and package pinning, then manages the PostgreSQL service lifecycle.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Configures Redis with password protection, memory and persistence settings, and an attempted PuppetDB-based node discovery path for cluster operation.
